headline: Director approved a $14k window-treatment change order for Collier Firm renovations; new rules cover employee communications and personnel contracts.
summary: The meeting elected Doug Thompson as Vice Chairman and Thomas O'Brien as Chairman. It also adopted rules requiring copies of written employee communications to the Director and review of personnel contracts by the Personnel Committee and the Board. The Director approved a $14k window-treatment change order for Collier Firm renovations under existing leasehold-improvement authority.
decisions: Elected Doug Thompson as Vice Chairman, all in favor.
Elected Thomas O'Brien as Chairman, all in favor.
Approved the amended minutes of the August 13, 2026 meeting, all in favor.
Approved the August 2026 bills paid, all in favor.

Approved two rules: written communications between board members and employees must include a copy to the Director, and all personnel contracts must be reviewed by the Personnel Committee and the Board, all in favor.
Director approved a $14k window-treatment change order for Collier Firm renovations under existing leasehold-improvement authority.
Decided that the board will continue to use .gov email addresses to conduct board business.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Member Donna Friday, nominating Doug Thompson for Vice Chairman, seconded by Member Thomas O'Brien. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Member Doug Thompson, nominating Thomas O'Brien for Chairman, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to approve the amended Board of Health Meeting Minutes of August 13, 2026. All in Favor. Motion carried.

Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to approve the August, 2026 Bills. Member Donna Friday questioned Legal Fees invoice timing as well as Directors and Officers Liability Insurance payment source. All in Favor. Motion carried.

Motion by Vice Chairman Doug Thompson, seconded by Member Kathy Langlais for: 1. Any written communication between board members and individual employees of the district must include a copy to the Director. 2. All personnel contracts to be reviewed by both the Personnel Committee and the Board. All in Favor. Motion carried.
with a $14k window-treatment change order approved this month under the Director's existing leasehold-improvement authority.
